City Parks Initiative

About GreenCity Tree Inventory

GreenCity Tree Inventory is a city-wide mapping project that tracks every street and park tree across our neighborhoods. Our municipal parks team uses this shared inventory to schedule routine inspections, record maintenance work, and care for trees throughout every season. By keeping accurate records of tree species, age, and canopy condition, we help protect and grow a healthier urban forest for the entire community.
